curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: identify words with the sounds /b/, /r/, /u/, and /g/ in a text

mission.title: identify words with the sounds /b/, /r/, /u/, and /g/ in a text

interactions.retryHint: Listen for the first sound in rain.

interactions.prompt: Sort each word by its first sound.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a word, then tap its first-sound group.
interactions.feedback: Great listening! You found all four target sounds.
interactions.retryHint: Stretch the first sound of each word.

interactions.prompt: Read: The goat runs to the bus. Which word begins with /g/?
interactions.retryHint: Look for the word starting with g.

interactions.prompt: Read: A red bug is under the rug. Which word begins with /u/?
interactions.retryHint: Say the first sound in under.

interactions.prompt: Match each sound to a word from the text: A big rabbit runs under a green gate.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a sound, then tap its matching word.
interactions.feedback: Brilliant! You identified every target sound in the text.
interactions.retryHint: Read the first letter of each target word.
